{{Quote|The fact that I’m very fond of Brul has nothing whatsoever to do with my approval of their application.|[[Wynn Dorvan]], to his [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|own office]]|<ref name="FJ" />}}
'''Brul''' was a succulent [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] found on [[Xilxash]],<ref name="FJ" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Yminis sector/Legends|Yminis sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &ndash; based on corresponding data for [[Xilxash system/Legends|Xilxash system]]</ref>
Around [[44 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Xilxash was notable largely for its [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural]] contributions, particularly the fruit brul, which was all the rage in the best [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurants]]. For example, [[The Nook]], a breakfast establishment near Coruscant's [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], served fresh [[brul juice]].<ref name="FJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The fruit brul was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]'', which was written by [[Christie Golden]]<ref name="FJ" /> and released in [[2011]].<ref name="Amazon">{{RandomHouseOld|url=book/68770/star-wars-fate-of-the-jedi-ascension-by-christie-golden|text=Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi: Ascension}}</ref>
